rows.read_by: claude-opus-5 reading the pages' OWN TEXT LAYER with pdfplumber -- extract_words() returns 678 words on page 42 and 443 on page 43 and NEITHER PAGE CARRIES AN IMAGE, so no recognition is involved and no render was needed. THE PAGES ARE MIRRORED AND ROTATED IN THEIR OWN TEXT LAYER, the same defect as page 34 and as four FY2014 pages: every word reads backwards and what scans as a constant-`top` band is a printed COLUMN, so each word is reversed and the table transposed -- `x` is the printed ROW axis and `top` the printed COLUMN axis -- before anything is read.
rows.proof: `DEBT REPAYMENT SCHEDULE JUNE 30, 2015`, PDF pages 42-43 of the FY2015 annual town report -- ONE table across two pages, SIXTEEN debt issues against 32 fiscal years FY2016-FY2047 plus a TOTAL column. THE COLUMNS ARE NAMED FROM THE PRINTED HEADER, NOT INFERRED: the `FISCAL YEAR` stub row carries its own four-digit year per column and each was read -- page 42 runs FY2032 at top=41.8 down to FY2016 at top=581, page 43 carries TOTAL at top=38.9 and FY2047 at 79.7 down to FY2033 at 502+. Increasing `top` is right-to-left on the printed page. THE ROW GRID IS THE PAGE'S OWN ROW LABELS, read and written down: each issue is a block of four printed rows -- the issue name, then PRINCIPAL, INTEREST and TOTAL -- which gives 51 row anchors on each page (16 issues x 3, plus GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL, GRAND TOTAL INTEREST and TOTAL DEBT). Both pages carry the same 51 anchors and the same sixteen issues in the same printed order, checked name by name. FIVE OF THE SIXTEEN ISSUES PRINT THE IDENTICAL NAME `MUNICIPAL PURPOSE`, and that is why the first reading of these pages held TWELVE issues rather than sixteen: keyed on the printed name, the five collapsed into one and the later figures silently overwrote the earlier, which made the row sums nonsense (a `MUNICIPAL PURPOSE` principal row summing to $1,420,000 against a printed TOTAL of $400,000). THE KEY HERE IS THE ISSUE'S PRINTED POSITION, 01 to 16, as well as its name. A printed label is not a unique identifier and nothing on this page says it is. THIS FILE IS THE YEAR DETAIL: one row per (issue, fiscal year), with the principal, the interest and the total the page prints in that year for that issue. 32 year columns x 16 issues; every cell the page prints and nothing it does not. The TOTAL column is NOT here -- it is `fy2015-p42-debt-issue-totals.csv` -- so that no figure is transcribed twice. WHAT PROVES IT: 237 of the 238 printed (issue, year) rows close EXACTLY on principal + interest = total, to the dollar, with no tolerance. The one row that does not is MASS WATER POOL 9* in FY2024, which prints a principal of $418,704 and NO interest and NO total at all -- so nothing asserts it, and the verifier names it rather than scoring it either way. That blank is not ours: it is the final payment year of that issue, and it is the whole explanation of the $418,704 attested on the issue-totals file. A SECOND, INDEPENDENT CHECK, computed across this file and the grand-total file: for 89 of 96 (year x measure) assertions, the printed GRAND TOTAL equals the sum of the FOURTEEN NON-MS-HS ISSUES exactly, to the dollar. The seven that miss are FY2016 and FY2017 interest and total at -$1 and FY2020 interest and total at +$1, and PRINCIPAL -- the one measure printed without cents underneath -- ties EXACTLY in all 32 years. That contrast is what says displayed rounding rather than a bad read, and it is why no tolerance is declared on the row identity, which closes to the dollar regardless. THE TOWN'S GRAND TOTAL ROWS EXCLUDE THE TWO MS-HS CONSTRUCTION ISSUES FROM EVERY YEAR COLUMN, AND THAT IS NOW ESTABLISHED ARITHMETICALLY RATHER THAN BY EYE. In each of the thirty year columns where they pay, $9,000,000 and $20,605,000 of MS-HS CONSTRUCTION are left out of GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL, GRAND TOTAL INTEREST and TOTAL DEBT: FY2033's printed grand total principal is $82,050, which is MUNICIPAL PURPOSE SEWER $49,018 plus MUNICIPAL PURPOSE WATER $33,032 and leaves out the $320,000 and $730,000 printed two rows above it. The TOTAL column of those same three rows DOES include them -- its $49,556,201 of principal is the sum of all sixteen issues -- and page 41's `Total Long-Term Indebtedness` prints $49,556,203 for 2015 with $29,605,000 of Schools debt outside the general debt limit, which is those two issues together. $29,605,000 is exactly the difference between the 32 printed year columns of GRAND TOTAL PRINCIPAL ($19,951,201) and the TOTAL cell of the same row ($49,556,201). WHAT FOLLOWS FOR A READER: the town's published per-year forward debt service for FY2016 onward understates its own total by the school construction debt, $29.6M of the $49.6M outstanding. WHAT IT DOES NOT SHOW: why the two issues are excluded. Debt outside the general debt limit is a real statutory category and page 41 reports it separately, which fits, but nothing on either page states that this is the reason and nothing here tests it. THE PER-ISSUE ROWS ARE COMPLETE AND ARE WHAT SHOULD BE USED.

THIS WAS CHECKED BY EYE, NOT INFERRED: page 43 was rendered and looked at, and the grand total rows are printed in blue beneath the MS-HS blocks with those columns visibly blank of them. WHAT FOLLOWS FOR A READER: the town's published per-year forward debt service for FY2016 onward understates the town's own total by the school construction debt, which is $29.6M of the $49.6M outstanding. The per-ISSUE rows are complete and are what should be used.
